anomalies.observed: The netlist contains two separate MCU components, U3 (ATtiny45-20P) and U4 (ATtiny13V-10S), and connects them pin-for-pin to the same nets: U3.5/U4.5 on NET0002, U3.6/U4.6 on NET0001, U3.7/U4.7 on NET0005, U3.1/U4.1 on NET0006, and both VCC/GND pins on +5V/GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes "an ATtiny-driven fan controller" (singular). A normal fan controller should contain one MCU, or, if multiple footprints are intended as alternatives, only one should be populated/marked DNP. The exported netlist shows no DNP-style indication and presents both MCUs as active components.
anomalies.impact: If both U3 and U4 are assembled, their output pins (especially the ISP/I2C lines and fan PWM/MISO line) drive the same nets in parallel, causing bus contention, undefined fan control, and possible damage. If only one is intended to be populated, the design files do not indicate that and effectively include an extra MCU component.

parsed.summary: The most likely anomaly is the presence of two ATtiny MCUs wired in parallel on the same control and bus nets, which is inconsistent with a single ATtiny-driven fan controller unless one footprint is explicitly an unpopulated alternative.
